title: WHBench: Evaluating Frontier LLMs with Expert-in-the-Loop Validation on Women's Health Topics
abstract: arXiv:2604.00024v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for medical guidance, but women's health remains under-evaluated in benchmark design. We present the Women's Health Benchmark (WHBench), a targeted evaluation suite of 47 expert-crafted scenarios across 10 women's health topics, designed to expose clinically meaningful failure modes including outdated guidelines, unsafe omissions, dosing errors, and equity-related blind spots. We evaluate 22 models using a 23-criterion rubric spanning clinical accuracy, completeness, safety, communication quality, instruction following, equity, uncertainty handling, and guideline adherence, with safety-weighted penalties and server-side score recalculation. Across 3,102 attempted responses (3,100 scored), no model mean performance exceeds 75 percent; the best model reaches 72.1 percent. translated_title: WHBench：基于专家在环验证的前沿大语言模型在女性健康主题上的评估基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于医疗指导，但女性健康在基准设计中仍然缺乏充分评估。我们提出了女性健康基准（WHBench），这是一个包含47个由专家精心设计的场景、覆盖10个女性健康主题的针对性评估套件，旨在揭示具有临床意义的失败模式，包括过时的指南、不安全的遗漏、剂量错误以及公平性相关的盲点。我们使用涵盖临床准确性、完整性、安全性、沟通质量、指令遵循、公平性、不确定性处理和指南依从性等23项标准的评分细则，对22个模型进行了评估，并采用安全加权惩罚和服务器端分数重新计算机制。在3,102次尝试回答中（3,100次被评分），没有任何模型的平均表现超过75%；最佳模型达到72.1%。即使是顶级模型也显示出较低的全对率和伤害率上的显著差异。评估者间信度中等……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出WHBench——一个由专家深度参与验证构建的女性健康评估基准，通过对22个前沿大语言模型在47个专家设计的场景和23项标准下的系统测试，发现没有任何模型的平均表现超过75%，暴露了现有模型在女性健康领域的安全性、临床准确性和公平性方面的重大缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WHBench, an expert-in-the-loop validated benchmark with 47 scenarios across 10 women's health topics, which evaluates 22 frontier LLMs using a 23-criterion rubric and reveals that no model exceeds 75% mean performance, exposing clinically meaningful failure modes in safety, accuracy, and equity.
